B1-BVA-02 Samuel keeps his Fishball work board available — W0: if retained, recent-done count doneWindowHours is an integer 0…168, never the panel cutoff
B1-UC-CONFIG-A Samuel keeps his Fishball work board available — W0: [formerly B1-EP-01] inject is a boolean
B1-EP-V-04 Samuel keeps his Fishball work board available — W0: the constants carry the six statuses and the frozen limits

K1-MCP-UC-01-M | Use Case | Samuel returns to current, not stale, attention — Start with no report; accept {3,1,1700000000123}, then {5,0,1700000000999}; submit unread=10000; explicitly detach, reauthenticate and publish {7,2,1700000001000}. => Shared fixtures specify zero -> {3,true} -> {5,false}; invalid report preserves the last valid value; detach resets zero; reauth stays zero until current report. Frozen validator/result/error binding requires S3/K1, not historical control frames. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-UC-01-A1 | Use Case | Samuel’s plain MCP manager does not need attention or a callback server — Use a semantically compatible control-only external client with no attention/intake/notifications/push, followed by an authorized offer-capable client that never polls. => Shared conformance distinguishes zero-unread/user-owned nondelegated cards from default-on delegated cards waiting; neither profile restores timers or needs a reverse MCP server. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-UC-01-E1 | Use Case | A malformed report does not poison Samuel’s next valid update — Shared vectors place unread=10000 after valid {5,0,null}, then {2,1,null}; compare the frozen rejection and accepted-result fixtures. => Exact reviewed domain refusal leaves {5,false}; next valid report accepts {2,true}. No unfrozen tool/export/error is presumed. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-EP-01 | EP | Shared attention fixtures cover zero and current epoch-ms values — Validate independently {unread:0,importantUnread:0,latestAt:null} and {unread:3,importantUnread:1,latestAt:1700000000123}; validate accepted:true result. => Both payload classes and accepted result conform to the frozen optional schema without a custom request/envelope/handshake. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-EP-02 | EP | Missing required attention field is a separate invalid partition — Omit unread, importantUnread and latestAt in independent otherwise-valid vectors. => Each vector has the frozen domain refusal and cannot replace the last valid attention value. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-EP-03 | EP | Wrong attention primitive types cannot coerce to counts — Independently replace unread with "3", importantUnread with "1", latestAt with "1700000000123" and payload with null. => Each invalid class is refused independently, with no numeric/string coercion or state change. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-EP-04 | EP | Unknown attention field has an explicit shared rejection fixture — Use otherwise-valid {unread:3,importantUnread:1,latestAt:null,extra:true}. => Unknown field is refused per the pinned test outline; S3/K1 freezes exact error mapping rather than silently ignoring it. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-EP-05 | EP | Shared fixtures do not equate copied declarations with conformance — Compare genuinely timer-free client behavior to a client advertising identical declarations but retaining approval expiry; include malformed declaration. => Conformance requires independent behavioral evidence and refusal fixtures; declaration echo or npm/MCP version alone is insufficient. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-EP-06 | EP | Removed descriptor expiry has no legacy exception — Permission/question/plan-review descriptor vectors independently carry past, future and null expiresAt; compare the field-absent vectors. => Field-absent conforms; any removed-field presence refuses with the frozen mapping. Grant and attachment hostRef expiries remain separate legitimate domains. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1 + K2; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-BVA-01 | BVA | Unread lower boundary uses three values — Keep importantUnread=0/latestAt=null; use unread -1 / 0 / 1. => -1 refuses; 0 and 1 conform. Cases assert the frozen validator, not an authored local predicate. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-BVA-02 | BVA | Unread upper boundary uses three values — Keep importantUnread=0/latestAt=null; use unread 9998 / 9999 / 10000. => 9998 and 9999 conform; 10000 refuses with frozen mapping; no state update on refusal. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-BVA-03 | BVA | Important unread lower and dependent upper boundaries — At unread=5 use importantUnread -1 / 0 / 1 and 4 / 5 / 6; add a fractional 0.5 independently. => -1, 6 and 0.5 refuse; 0/1/4/5 conform; relationship importantUnread <= unread is enforced independently of unreadMax. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-BVA-04 | BVA | Timestamp null, epoch zero and nonintegral class are distinguished — Use latestAt null / 0 / 1700000000123 / 1.5 with fixed valid counts; use unread=0.5 separately. => Null, zero and epoch-ms integer conform; fractional timestamp or count refuses. No unapproved timestamp max/safe-integer/negative rule is invented. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-DT-01 | Decision Table | K1-R1 required semantics are mandatory but attention is optional — Compatible semantic controls without attention/intake vs missing required timer-free semantics, old custom consumer/new connector, and new consumer/old connector. => Fixtures permit only semantically compatible controls and optional degradation; every required mismatch refuses before delegation. No minor-negotiation fixture survives. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-DT-02 | Decision Table | K1-R2 answer authority requires a live offer, not ack or discoverability — Current owner/generation + offer-capable + live offer vs control-only, retired offer, foreign offer and mailbox ack without decision authority. => Only the fully authorized live offer may commit; rejection fixtures preserve the existing user result/live card without a second settlement. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-ST-01 | State Transition | Attention is latest valid report, not maximum timestamp or count — Accept {7,2,1700000001000}, then valid {1,0,1700000000123}, then malformed unread=10000. => Conformance vector expects {1,false} after the later valid report despite its older latestAt; malformed report leaves it unchanged. latestAt is payload data, not a new ordering authority. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-ST-02 | State Transition | Shared logical-session reset table distinguishes ordinary close — After {5,0,null}, close HTTP/TCP or optional GET/SSE; compare logical authenticated-session invalidation, explicit detach and fresh reauth with no report. => Ordinary close preserves {5,false}; logical loss/detach reset {0,false}; fresh reauth stays zero until report. Isolated timeout alone does not prove session loss. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-EP-08 | EP | Shared push event/ack fixtures enforce scope without a second control API — Publish reviewed conformance vectors for stable msg-17, scoped permission offer-17, approved unscoped notice, durable-acceptance ack, malformed event scope, foreign/replaced-incarnation ack and a session-control payload on push. => Valid event/acceptance classes conform; each invalid class has its frozen rejection mapping. Ack means accepted, not answered; null source is permitted only for approved unscoped notices; no control envelope or reverse MCP is introduced. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-EP-07 | EP | Shared unread maximum remains 9999 without preserving an old export — Observe the shared attention limit and its 9999/10000 conformance vectors through the S3/K1-reviewed schema/limit binding; do not import a parked old-control export. => The shared maximum is exactly 9999. Approval of a new callable location is required before execution; no old file/export survival or custom-control compatibility is asserted. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

K1-MCP-UC-02-M | Use Case | Samuel sees the connector publish the shared attention journey — Drive the UC-01-M vector through the frozen MCP adapter and observe the real connector state.unread boundary using a local in-process safe fixture, without DSH/server launch. => Real state, last-valid retention, detach/reset and re-report match shared vectors; browser badge/important alert rendering remains FN-A integration, not fixture evidence. [TODO MCP-SERVER + X0-W + FN-A; W1 integration]

K1-MCP-ST-03 | State Transition | Runtime attention survives request/stream close but not actual authority loss — Publish {5,1,null}, end ordinary HTTP/TCP and optional SSE, issue next same-session request, then invalidate logical auth and reauthenticate. => Real state stays {5,true} across ordinary closes, resets only on actual auth loss/detach, and stays zero until re-report; revoked old owner cannot publish. [TODO MCP-SERVER + X0-W; W1 integration]

K1-MCP-DT-03 | Decision Table | Runtime compatibility refuses both mismatched peer directions — Run compatible new/new, old-custom/new and new-built-in/old-control with optional attention absent; try a second logical owner and revoked credentials independently. => Compatible controls work with zero unread; mismatches/second-owner/revoked auth refuse before domain traffic/delegation. No version-only/copy-declaration shortcut. [TODO MCP-SERVER + X0-W + K2; W1 integration]

K1-MCP-DT-04 | Decision Table | Breaking removal preserves unrelated services and upgrades every built-in consumer — Apply the S3 inventory to built artifacts: obsolete control endpoint/exports/imports absent, new shared profile/event snapshot present, compatible built-in bindings and peer excluding old-control releases. => One MCP control plane, no legacy adapter/migration/dual-control release. Existing lifecycle/embed/admin/provider-sync remain; no unapproved numeric package version is asserted. [TODO MCP-SERVER + X0-W + FB-PUSH + K2; W1 integration]

K1-MCP-ST-04 | State Transition | Runtime offers wait and settle exactly once by first commit — Delegate permission/question/plan-review to an authorized external client without opt-in; never poll and advance time, then race user vs agent commits in both orders. => No off setting or time-driven decision; first COMMITTED result wins and clears/returns/notifies once. Questions/plans bypass watchdog and watchdog-only decisions never auto-wake Fishball. [TODO MCP-SERVER + K2 + FB-PUSH + X0-I + X0-A; W1 integration]

MS1-UC-01-M | Use Case | Samuel delegates a read without running an agent server — On EACH host 0.2.1-rc.5 / 0.2.2-rc.1, provision an isolated manager, initialize a plain MCP client, list controls and read related session mcp-work-17; no callback listener, notification handler or reverse MCP server exists. => The chosen explicitly packaged server dependency supports one-way list/call; the scoped read returns its fixture data; the spike records version, dependency and observed outcomes without secrets. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-UC-01-A1 | Use Case | Samuel uses controls without optional delivery features — Repeat the read with no attention, no notifications/resources, no push and no offer-intake capability. => Control-only access works; the client is not advertised as an approval manager and no delegated card or idle wake is promised. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-UC-01-E1 | Use Case | An unrelated local process cannot take over Samuel’s work — A second isolated client supplies invalid authentication and copies the admitted clientInfo/session metadata, then attempts list/call. => Metadata/locality does not authenticate it; no scoped DSH operation runs and no credential is exposed in errors or report evidence. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-EP-01 | EP | Runtime-only packaging does not borrow server development dependencies — Resolve/load the chosen explicit server/transport dependency from a disposable packaged installation against each supported host; no repository devDependency fallback. => Both installations provide every required runtime dependency, with a captured install/resolve result; stock MCP-client presence alone is not accepted as server proof. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-EP-02 | EP | Endpoint discovery and secret projection remain private — Use newly generated test-only canaries for manager A and push-channel authority; inspect launcher/config discovery, model context, tool arguments/results, logs, UI/config export and stdio argv if chosen. => Only private provisioning receives secrets; no canary or secret-bearing URL appears in observable outputs; stdio uses private environment/IPC, never argv. Never load real credentials. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-EP-03 | EP | Public or wildcard listener is not local-only — Probe the proposed binding with loopback, LAN/wildcard listener configuration, foreign Host, foreign Origin and attempted wildcard CORS; keep each rejection independently observable. => Only the concrete loopback/authenticated origin policy admits calls; an unsuitable existing listener is rejected in favor of an explicit local-only option. No remote-access claim. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-EP-04 | EP | Structured refusal survives both stock DSH clients — Through each stock client, return one scoped domain refusal limit-exceeded, one reason-too-large and a distinct MCP/JSON-RPC protocol failure using the proposed result mapping. => Machine domain codes survive client conversion with text fallback; protocol failure remains distinguishable. isError/prose alone is not accepted evidence. S3 later freezes the selected representation. [TODO MCP-S1 + MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]

MS1-BVA-01 | BVA | UTF-8 message cap is a domain bound, not frame length — Send message bodies of 65,535 / 65,536 / 65,537 UTF-8 bytes using ASCII and multibyte 界 with an ASCII tail; account for bytes, not JSON Schema character counts. => First two reach the fake domain boundary unchanged; 65,537 refuses limit-exceeded before delivery. MCP frame/SSE bounds are separately identified, not equated to the body cap. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-BVA-02 | BVA | Raw caller reason cap is independent of descriptor text — Use raw caller reasons at 8,191 / 8,192 / 8,193 UTF-8 bytes, independently from the message body, including a multibyte string. => 8,191 and 8,192 are admitted; 8,193 refuses reason-too-large before forwarding. The independent 500-character descriptor/decision reason bound is preserved. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-BVA-03 | BVA | Start title requires visible content without an invented upper bound — Use empty, whitespace/invisible-only, visible one-character 修 and visible 201-character start titles in otherwise valid start calls. => Empty/invisible-only is refused before creation; visible content is not refused merely by an invented 200-character session.start cap. Descriptor/prompt title bounds remain separate. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-DT-01 | Decision Table | S1-R1 manager read stays in scope — Authenticated manager A reads related mcp-work-17 with required control capabilities satisfied. => Exactly one allowed read executes; no unrelated session is exposed. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-DT-02 | Decision Table | S1-R2 unrelated read cannot use raw tool discovery as authority — Authenticated manager A calls a discovered read control for unrelated mcp-private-88. => Scope is refused before the domain read; tool discovery confers no session authority. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-DT-03 | Decision Table | S1-R3 side agent cannot bypass manager façade — Read-only side agent calls a raw MCP mutating control, bypassing the manager façade attempt. => X12/X13 scope still blocks it before any domain mutation; no globally exposed raw tool bypass exists. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-DT-04 | Decision Table | S1-R4 healthy send gate still applies to raw and image paths — Use an otherwise admitted manager message/image-send to mcp-work-17 with healthy watchdog but no active brief; compare effective-off failure. => Healthy gate refusal sends nothing; failed/off watchdog passes to Fishball ownership. Spike shows where the façade applies X19, never a watchdog-fault halt. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-ST-01 | State Transition | Physical HTTP/SSE closure is not logical authentication loss — Authenticate and initialize, close one ordinary HTTP/TCP request or optional GET/SSE stream, then issue the next authenticated control request for the same logical session. => Authority remains valid; no false detach/fallback is inferred solely from short requests or absent SSE. The spike identifies actual logical-session invalidation evidence. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS1-ST-02 | State Transition | Revocation fences the admitted owner immediately — Admit owner A, revoke it, attempt a fresh authenticated control call using A’s prior credential/session, then enroll authorized owner B. => A cannot act after revocation; B does not revive A. Only one logical attached owner controls sessions, with server-bound identity rather than caller metadata. [TODO MCP-S1; W0 acceptance]

MS2-UC-01-M | Use Case | Samuel’s idle Fishball reacts to one update once — On each supported host, use one generated-auth event msg-17 from mcp-work-17 while Fishball is idle; commit receiver acceptance/queue and lose the delivery ack; replay and reconstruct the fixture from the same disposable durable store. => One stable identity reconciles to one routed queue entry and one wake; a pending reservation alone is not delivered. Evidence distinguishes durable acceptance from model answer. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-UC-01-A1 | Use Case | Samuel chooses an external manager that is not currently running — Authorize external intake/answer capability, delegate offer-17 and make no poll at all; advance the fixture clock beyond former approval windows. => Default-on delegated permission/question/plan offers wait, with no off switch or timer settlement/escalation; a future bounded fetch can recover them. No callback server is required. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-UC-01-E1 | Use Case | Samuel keeps control when Fishball push becomes unavailable — With valid MCP and a live delegated offer, fail first-party push; attempt a late answer, then recover the push channel. => Controls remain usable; offers go to user fallback and accepted-but-unprocessed child decisions suspend; late retired answers fail and recovery does not retro-offer user-owned cards. No managed session is stopped. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-EP-01 | EP | Mailbox read is not acknowledgement — Poll msg-17, advance the opaque cursor and poll/replay without a durable-acceptance ack. => Stable identity remains available until ack; fetching or receiving a control result never consumes the durable item implicitly. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-EP-02 | EP | Foreign cursor is rejected independently — Owner B submits owner A’s valid-looking cursor; no ack or answer is included. => Refused without exposing A’s page, consuming an item or moving A’s cursor; principal/generation binding is proved. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-EP-03 | EP | Foreign ack is rejected independently — Owner B acknowledges A’s msg-17 with no foreign cursor in the request. => Refused; A’s item remains pending and no answer authority is granted. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-EP-04 | EP | Retention gap cannot silently skip work — Present an authentic cursor made stale by a controlled retention gap while ordinary notice msg-18 remains live. => Explicit resync/gap/truncation outcome; no silent success that skips undelivered work or deletion of the live ordinary notice. S3 freezes exact representation. [TODO MCP-S2 + MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]

MS2-EP-05 | EP | Push capability cannot become a second control plane — Use a scoped first-party event/ack channel; attempt session mutation over it and attempt binding an arbitrary external callback URL. => Channel authenticates events/acks only; both control and arbitrary-URL dial attempts are refused; no reverse MCP or per-watchdog endpoint is introduced. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-BVA-01 | BVA | Poll is bounded and makes truncation explicit — At the proposed page size N, populate N-1 / N / N+1 items with ordered stable ids; also request empty and over-limit pages under the proposed limit policy. => At most the admitted bound returns, order and next position are explicit, remainder stays recoverable, and overflow behavior is documented. N and invalid-limit mapping require S3 approval, not an invented number. [TODO MCP-S2 + MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]

MS2-BVA-02 | BVA | Retrieval wait is finite but never a decision deadline — For proposed wait budget W below both caller/server timeouts, test no events, an event at W-1, wait expiry at W and client cancellation; use a controlled clock rather than wall-clock sleeping. => If long-poll is implemented it returns an empty/bounded page or cancellation within budget; cancelling a wait neither acknowledges work nor decides/escalates a card. If omitted, bounded poll remains sufficient and optional long-poll is explicitly N/A. [TODO MCP-S2 + MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]

MS2-DT-01 | Decision Table | S2-R1 plain external offer-capable client needs no opt-in — Valid control + authorized supported intake/answer, no notifications and no first-party push. => Delegation is on by default; no setting/API config disables it. Idle offers wait until retrieval or an actual authority/user transition. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-DT-02 | Decision Table | S2-R2 controls alone do not authorize offers — Valid control but missing authorized intake/answer capability, irrespective of tools being discoverable. => Controls stay available; nondelegated cards stay user-owned and guessed offer answers fail. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-DT-03 | Decision Table | S2-R3 live push cannot replace lost MCP authority — Invalidate the logical authenticated MCP session while authenticated first-party push remains alive. => Delegation withdraws, stale answers fail and user fallback remains live; push alone cannot grant control authority; no stop. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-DT-04 | Decision Table | S2-R4 healthy permission claim routes before Fishball queueing — Permission offer for mcp-work-17 with a current healthy watchdog claim; compare ordinary notice routing separately. => Permission wakes only that claim incarnation/decision agent; ordinary notices follow existing filters, not blanket watchdog forwarding; no automatic Fishball wake for watchdog-only terminal result. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-DT-05 | Decision Table | S2-R5 watchdog fault means Fishball ownership, not halt — Same permission with watchdog failed/off/not ready, including a previously held claim. => Claim authority is released; Fishball receives the open permission once; sends pass and no managed-session stop/halt is caused by the failure (U20). [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-DT-06 | Decision Table | S2-R6 questions and plan reviews always bypass watchdog — Question then plan-review offer from a session with active/paused healthy claim, followed by dormant/failed claim state. => Every independent question/review reaches Fishball, never watchdog queue/context/claim; optional refinement is independent of the answer (U21). [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-ST-01 | State Transition | Unaccepted reservation is recovered, not falsely acked — Persist pending msg-17 reservation, fail before queue storage commits, reconstruct receiver and replay msg-17. => Reservation is reconciled/retried and eventually durably accepted once; no ack before durable queue acceptance and no lost notice. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-ST-02 | State Transition | Accepted queue entry survives lost receipt and restart — Commit queue acceptance of msg-17, fail before ack; reconstruct the receiving adapter, replay and recover idle activation. => Existing acceptance is reconciled, ack is retried and one user-visible routed wake exists; history-wide dedupe is not inferred from DSH pending ids alone. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-ST-03 | State Transition | Pull-to-push handover has one ledger consumer — Begin a pull delivery, atomically transfer the same ledger to first-party push, then submit old pull-incarnation ack/claim and a replay. => Old incarnation cannot ack/claim replacement work; identity is stable and handover does not independently consume/deliver twice. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-ST-04 | State Transition | Commit order, not first attempt or ack, determines settlement — Agent fetches/acks/attempts allow first but pause its commit; user reject commits first, then release agent. Repeat with commit order reversed. => First COMMITTED outcome remains immutable; one requesting-tool result, clear and eligible notification occur. Earlier fetch/ack/attempt is not a win. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-ST-05 | State Transition | Push recovery does not revive a retired offer — Offer-capable -> push failure/user fallback -> push recovery/new incarnation; replay old offer-17 and then create fresh offer-18. => offer-17 stays user-owned/retired, late answer fails; only fresh authorized offer-18 may delegate; notices retain stable identities. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS2-ST-06 | State Transition | Silence, ordinary stream close and isolated timeout do not withdraw authority — Leave an external client idle with no polls, close optional SSE and simulate one unconfirmed request timeout without proof of logical-session loss. => Offers remain waiting and authority remains unchanged; the unknown mutation is unconfirmed and is not automatically retried. [TODO MCP-S2; W0 acceptance]

MS3-UC-01-M | Use Case | Samuel’s two clients agree before a coordinated upgrade — After reviewed S1/S2 evidence from both hosts, review the shared profile for a built-in Fishball and a plain external client with no callback server. => Review freezes exact controls/results/errors/capabilities and event/ack/attention identifiers, ownership/generation fencing and first-committed semantics; both consumers can implement one reviewed baseline, not copied declarations. [TODO MCP-S1 + MCP-S2 + MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]

MS3-UC-01-A1 | Use Case | Samuel retains limited controls with no optional features — Review a client profile with required timer-free controls but no attention, offer intake, notification handler or push. => Profile expressly permits scoped control, zero unread projection and user-owned nondelegated cards; it does not claim idle wake or make optional channels mandatory. [TODO MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]

MS3-UC-01-E1 | Use Case | An unverified spike cannot silently become a frozen API — S1 or S2 is unresolved on one supported host, or only source feasibility is reported without the required acceptance observations. => Dependent exact naming/result/error freeze is withheld with an owner-named gap; no invented module/export or failing import is used as a proxy for acceptance. [TODO MCP-S1 + MCP-S2 + MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]

MS3-EP-01 | EP | Required and optional semantics have independent conformance fixtures — Review compatible, missing required timer-free behavior, malformed declarations, optional attention absent and authorized intake absent as distinct fixtures. => Frozen profile names exact requirements and refusal mapping; npm/MCP version or declaration echo is never behavioral proof. Optional absence does not relax timer-free semantics. [TODO MCP-S3 + K1; W0 acceptance]

MS3-EP-02 | EP | Domain refusal mapping is machine-readable after client conversion — Freeze the S1-tested mapping for limit-exceeded, reason-too-large, expired, unavailable and queue-full, separate from MCP/JSON-RPC errors and transport unconfirmed outcomes. => Each maps to an exact reviewed result shape/code with text fallback and retry meaning; isError-only loss of structured data cannot be the default contract. [TODO MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]

MS3-EP-03 | EP | Minimal push contract contains no parallel controls — Review stable message identity, kind/source scope, offer correlation, opaque principal/generation cursor, gap/resync, durable-acceptance ack and server-bound channel incarnation fields. => Names/shapes/error mapping and required/nullability rules become explicit only after S2; events/acks carry no second control API, reverse MCP or per-watchdog route. [TODO MCP-S2 + MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]

MS3-BVA-01 | BVA | Freeze independently bounded domains rather than one envelope cap — Review 64 KiB message/forwarded-body, 8 KiB raw reason, 500-character descriptor reason, 9999 unread, existing read/attachment caps and proposed poll/frame/backlog bounds. => Units, defaults, each invalid-neighbor mapping and independently configurable limits are explicit; no invented 200-character start-title cap or approval deadline is added. [TODO MCP-S1 + MCP-S2 + MCP-S3; W0 acceptance]
